description: This PHP source file defines the ParserFactory class, responsible for creating and returning appropriate parser objects based on view, module, and package parameters within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder framework.

classes.name: ParserFactory
classes.description: A factory class for instantiating specific parser objects based on the view type, module, and package context. It supports overrides and various parser types used within SuiteCRM's ModuleBuilder.

methods.name: getParser
methods.description: Creates and returns a parser object corresponding to the specified view, module, package, and optional subpanel. Handles special cases for different view types and overrides via separate parser classes.

methods.name: checkForParserClass
methods.description: Checks for the existence of specific parser class files matching the view and package context, then instantiates and returns the parser if found.

methods.name: checkForStudioParserOverride
methods.description: Checks for customized parser overrides defined in studio modules and returns an appropriate parser instance if available.
